item.title: Amish Fall Farmhouse Experience at Old Windmill Farm — Fri Nov 6 — Old Windmill Farm
item.description:
An autumn afternoon in our farm kitchen. Join us as we bake bread, churn butter from our own cows’ cream, and press apple cider with a traditional hand-cranked apple press. Then sit down and enjoy all three together, with the freshly churned butter on the bread warm from the oven.
Press fresh cider with a traditional press Churn butter from our own cows’ cream Enjoy freshly baked bread Drink cider and eat bread with fresh butter A working farm kitchen, not a demonstration Advance reservations required
Part of the visit is outdoors – dress for the weather. Book This Tour
Source: Discover Lancaster

item.title: Lancaster City Scavenger Hunt — Fri Nov 6 — Unique Lancaster
item.description:
The Ultimate Lancaster Scavenger Hunt – Adventure, History & Hidden Gems! This is the best way to explore Lancaster City – hands down! Grab your friends or family, join our app, and get ready for a really fun time. The start time of this event is between 12:00 PM and 1:15 pm. You can complete all 3 hours of hands-on activities or stop whenever you are ready. The longer you stay in the game, the more freebies and local treats you earn from small businesses in downtown. Children under 6 years old are free with an adult ticket

item.title: Trains & Troops — Sat Nov 7 — Railroad Museum of PA
item.description:
Greet our men and women in uniform, including veterans, re-enactors, civilians and railroaders, representing the Civil War era forward to today. Experience military and railroading displays of equipment, vehicles, uniforms, memorabilia and much more, all amid our historic trains! Salute our veterans and active-duty service personnel, along with the Lancaster Red Rose Veterans Honor Guard, Saturday at 11:00 a.m. and Sunday at 1:00 p.m. Be inspired by patriotic music performed by the Lampeter-Strasburg Community Band, Saturday at 11:00 a.m., and enjoy The Victory Society’s World War II fashion show, Saturday at 2:00 p.m.

item.title: Evening Compline — Wed Nov 11, 9:00 PM — Saint James Episcopal Church
item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.
Source: Saint James Lancaster

item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.
